reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's dated complete USDY Portfolio Overview as of November 18, 2026 6:59:59pm EST (2026-11-18T23:59:59Z, archived verbatim at Wayback 2026-11-20T06:03:39Z) reports four positions: US Treasuries $1,998,496,978.13; SHVon $413,291,992.13; First Citizens Bank bank deposits $733,336.07; and Other Cash and Cash Equivalents $6,980.00. Their exact sum equals the same-page portfolio total of $2,412,529,286.33; weights use only this common denominator. The same-date Ankura Trust daily report Ondo USDY LLC_ATCAttest_261118.pdf (newest LLC daily attestation published as of November 25, 2026) reconciles to the exact cent on US Treasury Bills ($1,998,496,978.13 across 12 CUSIPs at Marex, WAM 188.50 days), First Citizens Select MMA deposits ($733,336.07), and StoneX cash ($6,980.00), totaling $1,999,237,294.20 in Permitted Assets against $1,965,264,239.90 LLC Token Principal Outstanding (ratio 1.017287); the same-date Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited Ankura daily report shows $416,001,922.98 in BVI USDY outstanding and zero direct US Treasuries. Although the live page on November 25 shows a newer November 20 overview ($2,406,667,555.31, US Treasuries $1,999,991,788.64, WAM 202.58 days) after CUSIP 912797UZ8 matured on November 19, no Ankura LLC daily report after November 18 is published yet, so composition and the T-bill roster bound are renewed together at November 18. The Portfolio Overview also reports WAM 156.26 days, YTM 4.16%, value of USDY outstanding $1,965,264,239.90, and a 156.9% collateralization ratio; outstanding value and collateralization ratio are issuer supplemental metrics and are not reconciled to combined circulating liabilities here. This independently dated issuer portfolio supersedes the October 28 observation. It does not reconcile current global USDY liabilities, establish all-USDY financial assurance, or assign OGM platform-wide collateral to USDY. The Treasury category WAM and the one-day WAM of SHVon, deposits and cash are not contractual maturity maxima or guaranteed liquidation times; no maturityDaysMax or immediate liquidity is inferred. SHVon retains the issuer tokenized-security layer, conservative high risk and unknown liquidity, rather than direct Treasury or direct ETF-share credit. The small other-cash/equivalents category remains explicitly unclassified in the combined portfolio view.
